steps.npc: I'm on duty, so you'll need to make this quick.

options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.npc: I typically hang out in the lab and keep an eye the newbies. Someone needs to make sure no one breaks anything or loses an eye.
Last week we had someone trying to churn butter in the agitator. They weren't around for long. I really wish they'd start properly vetting new society members.

options.text: Thanks! I'd better be going now.

steps.player: Thanks! I'd better be going now.

steps.npc: For me, its the Anti-leech lotion. I despise leeches.

steps.player: Oh, that's surprising. I don't think I've seen many around here...

steps.npc: You've obviously never been swimming anywhere in the Tlati Rainforest...
